create_Cifar_dataset: create a Cifar dataset dataclass with configurable batch size, normalization mode, and augmentation options
create_Cifar10_dataset: create a Cifar10 dataset dataclass that defaults to CIFAR10 variant with standard augmentation settings
create_Cifar100_dataset: create a Cifar100 dataset dataclass that enables cutout and keep_image_size by default
run_train_dataset: run the train_dataset method to get a shuffled, preprocessed, batched CIFAR training data iterator
run_eval_datasets: run the eval_datasets method to get a dictionary of preprocessed batched CIFAR evaluation iterators
